title: Service DTC alerts
description: Alerts for service scheduling, built from vehicle.diagnostics.dtc.v1. All derivations are in event time and use inputs only: deduplicate by event_id first, ignore arrival order, never read a processing-time clock. Input lateness is at most 300 seconds, so jobs must allow at least 300 seconds of lateness and drop nothing. Routing rule: emit one alert per distinct event_id with event_type = dtc, severity >= 3 and status = active; everything else is dropped. alert_id = UUIDv5(namespace f5179d15-0fd7-5b5f-bf53-0852eb22d3d5, name = the source event_id in lowercase canonical form, UTF-8). lat and lon are the source precise coordinates rounded to 2 decimals with HALF_UP: take the coordinate as an integer number of 1e-5 degrees (exact, since inputs have 5 decimals), round to the nearest multiple of 1000 with ties away from zero, then divide by 100000. HALF_UP rounding means: round to the nearest value at the stated scale, ties away from zero, computed on exact decimal values (integer arithmetic), never on binary floating point.

alert_id.description: UUIDv5 of the source event_id; see the schema description.

event_time.description: event_time of the source DTC event.
